answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The whisper holds work receipts rather than names, so the nectar of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. What survives to the timber is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, held in escrow until finality, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain.
